source.name: HighBarV3
source.status: historical source pin only; no product artifact or runtime acceptance

components.title: Peer-observer qualification identity gate
components.summary: Keeps the default qualification count at zero and requires the exact f5c83c6 peer-observer engine identity whenever a nonzero qualification count is selected.

flows.title: Default-off product configuration to exact observer source pin

steps.description: Declare empty identity pins and qualification count zero as the product defaults.
For nonzero qualification, require engine hash f5c83c6, the peer-observer additional version and the existing exact wire identity.

facts.statement: A nonzero HighBar factory replacement qualification count requires the exact f5c83c6 engine hash, BARC-01.5-fr5-peer-observer-v1 Headless additional version and frozen wire identity; default pins remain empty and the default count remains zero.
This source gate makes the observer dependency discoverable but does not identify a newly built engine or plugin artifact and does not establish native qualification.

open_questions: Which fresh engine and HighBar artifact hashes will bind this source pin after the missing generated protobuf dependency is resolved?
